Description: Responses of the untrained network to each scene, as arrays of 7 read-out layers x 120 images (order of stimulus_order.tsv). The analyses use layer_means_resp_face_cos_f_n. Computed with the face region of each scene occluded by a grey mask; used in run_masked_face_analyses.py (Supplementary Figure 6). The network, its training and how the responses were computed are not documented in this release.

layer_means_resp_face_l2_n_f.Description: Not used by the analysis code.

layer_means_resp_face_l2_f_n.Description: Not used by the analysis code.

layer_means_resp_face_cos_f_n.Description: Used as the CNN predictor: the representational distance between a scene with a face and the same scene without one (as described in code/run_masked_face_analyses.py; read in code/facescenes/encoding.py). Layer index 6, the last fully connected layer, is the predictor 'Untrained' with the face masked.
